conclusions.text: The 2007 source layers represent local communes in both countries; Burkina Faso's ADM3 code is not used alone to infer that role. All 224 exact issue IDs and names match the retained source features.

Thirty-three Benin child-to-department relationships lack a same-vintage official crosswalk; two Burkina current footprints have incompletely reproduced topology provenance. These 35 rows remain insufficient-evidence, and no error or correction is asserted.
All 224 locations and 30 scoped parent groups have explicit assessments. The packet does not certify full national or regional coverage, approve the regional envelope, or permit imports.

methods.description: Resolve exact scoped IDs to pinned geoBoundaries source IDs/names and establish country-specific territorial roles from official statistical sources and the exact Stanford catalog item; retain temporal and completeness limits.
methods.units: source features, locations and administrative parent groups

methods.area_method: WGS84 straight-source-edge ellipsoidal integral; Shapely planar lon/lat intersection numerator
methods.description: Diagnostic source/current and child/parent polygon overlays with positive identity and negative disjoint controls; no geometry is changed and overlaps do not establish legal boundaries.
methods.units: WGS84 ellipsoidal m2 and area fractions

methods.description: Compare neighboring current Atlas local-unit area distributions and source role/vintage metadata as context only.
Deterministically materialize exact roster, one assessment per location and parent, and control receipts.
methods.software: Python 3.12 standard library and pinned geometry dependencies
